about: Synthetic input for computeInsights(data, pack) with the proposed pack values in ../research.md section 7. 'expected.insights' must equal the output filtered to 'assertKinds' (null = every kind); 'expected.needs' is what insightNeeds returns for the same kinds. Times are UTC ISO; local dates use input.timeZone.

cases.description: 12 days of records, 2 attacks, 9 check-ins. Every insight is below its minimum: no insight, only what is still needed.
4 attacks all tagged stress in 10 days. A 4-of-4 trigger looks striking but rests on too little: nothing.
Exactly 5 attacks in the window. Triggers tagged at least twice are listed with count of 5; a trigger tagged once is not.
6 attacks, but 2 started before the 90-day window (window starts 2026-08-30 local). Only 4 count, so the trigger and time-of-day insights stay below their minimum.
10 attacks, 7 in the afternoon. Under an even spread a top count of 7 or more happens rarely (chance below 0.10), so the sentence 'most started in the afternoon' is allowed.
8 attacks spread 3/2/2/1. The counts are shown, but a top count of 3 out of 8 is what chance gives almost always: pattern is false, no 'most started' sentence. Weekday stays below its minimum of 12.
12 attacks, 6 on a Monday (local dates). Chance of a top weekday count of 6 or more under an even spread is about 0.03: pattern true.
5 attacks, only 2 with an answered debrief. Undebriefed attacks never count, even with relief keys: nothing.
4 debriefed attacks. dark_room helped 3 of 3, the user's triptan helped 2 of 3 doses, cold_pack 1 of 2. sleep was marked once only (below the per-entry minimum of 2) and is left out.

30 finished nights with a sleep answer: 6 under 6 h, 24 others. 4 of the 6 short nights were followed by an attack that day, 2 of the 24 other nights were. The attack at 02:30 on Nov 20 belongs to the record day Nov 19 (day starts at 04:00). Today's check-in is excluded: its day is not over.
16 finished nights but only 4 under 6 h: the comparison needs at least 5 on each side, so nothing is shown.
Last attack ended on Nov 20 (local), so the current stretch is 7 days. The longest stretch in the last 365 days runs between the Sep 2 and Oct 16 attacks.
The last record of any kind is 12 days old. Silence is not proof of no attacks, so the streak is withheld until a recent record exists.

Mexico City. An attack at 23:30 local on Oct 31 is 05:30 UTC on Nov 1 and must count for October. Tracking began Sep 10, so September is partial and earlier months are absent; November is partial (today is Nov 27).
